 It was an unexpected connection.
 An unexpected person came out of the mouth of Kuching City (Malaysia) coach Aidil Sharyn (49, Singapore). Lee Imsaeng was technical director of Naga World FC (Cambodia).
 Kuching will face Gangwon FC in Group H of the 2026-27 Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Champions League Two (ACL2) group stage at 7 p.m. on October 29 at Gangneung High1 Arena in Gangwon Province.
 사진 확대 Kuching City Idil Sharyn Historical Director. Photo = Reporter Lee Geun-seung 사진 확대 Kuching held his final training session at Gangneung High1 Arena at 6 p.m. on October 28. Photo = Reporter Lee Geun-seung 사진 확대 Kuching places importance on adapting to the cold in Korea. Photo = Reporter Lee Geun-seung Kuching is a Malaysian emerging powerhouse founded in 2015.
 Kuching started in the fourth division of Malaysia and made his first top league appearance in 2023. In the 2025-26 season, he won the runner-up prize in the Malaysian Super League (first division) and qualified for the first Asian club competition in the club's history.
 Sharyn Sousa was also nominated for the Malaysian Super League Coach Award in the 2025-26 season. Johor Darlle competed with Takjim's Cisco Munoz and Slangor's Kim Pangon. The honor of the award went to Cisco, but Sharyn was also an example of how he was recognized for his leadership on the Malaysian stage.
 This is what Sharyn, the head coach of the private school, told at a pre-match press conference held at Gangneung High1 Arena on the 28th, a day before the match against Gangwon.
 사진 확대 Kuching Sharyn, a private school coach who watches the team's training at Gangneung High1 Arena. Photo = Reporter Lee Geun-seung Q. Resolution for the match against Gangwon-do. 
 First of all, thank you for welcoming us. Tomorrow's match against Gangwon will be a difficult game. I know how good Gangwon is. Gangwon is a team with a good soccer style. Most of all, he is good at soccer. We are trying to show a good performance against such Gangwon. I will thoroughly prepare to play 90 minutes without regret.
 Q. Both Kuching and Gangwon have one draw and one loss in two group games. It's a showdown between two teams that desperately need to win. 
 Gangwon Province, like us, will not be satisfied with the results of the last two games. Both teams will do their best to win the game tomorrow. The most important thing now is the weather. The key is for players to adapt to the cold weather. The final adaptation training remains. I will take care of the players so that they can adapt to the weather as much as possible.
 Q. The team founded in 2015 is competing in the Asian Club for the first time. 
 Right. We are the team that was founded in 2015. It started in the fourth division of Malaysia and went up to the first division. Now it has grown to the point where it can compete in the Asian club competition on behalf of Malaysia. The best thing is that you can gain experience on a higher level of stage. Captain Petrus Sittemby, who also attended the press conference, joined the team in 2024. He is a player who has greatly helped the team develop. Me, the captain, and all the players are growing together while maintaining a good relationship. Participation in ACL2 is a great gift and opportunity for us. I hope this tournament will give us more experience and become a team that has grown to the next level. I'll do my best.
 사진 확대 Director Kim Pan-gon. Photo = Reporter Lee Geun-seung 사진 확대 Lee Imsaeng Naga World Technical Director. Photo = Reporter Lee Geun-seung Q. Nominated for the Malaysian Super League Coach Award in the 2025-26 season. Among the candidates was Korean leader Kim Pan-gon. Do you have any connection with director Kim Pan-gon. 
 To be honest, I don't have much relationship with director Kim Pan-gon. I just found out while playing against each other in the same league. Among Korean leaders, he has a deep relationship with director Lee Im-saeng. Director Lee Imsaeng is my mentor. When coach Lee Im-saeng led home United FC (Singapore), he worked together as a coach. I understand that he also worked as a technical director of the Korea Football Association recently. Even now, we keep in touch and continue to have a good relationship.
 [Gangneung = Lee Geun-seung, MK Sports Reporter]
